meta.promptText: Dark spots aur dull skin ke liye India mein konsa vitamin C serum kharidun?

response.text:
**Dull skin aur dark spots** ke liye India mein sabse practical choice usually **10% vitamin C serum** hota hai, especially agar aap beginner ho ya sensitive skin hai.[3] Agar **stubborn pigmentation** hai aur skin vitamin C tolerate karti hai, to **15%** tak upgrade kiya ja sakta hai.[3]

Aapke liye best pick choose karne ka simple rule:

| Skin need | Better option | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| Beginner / sensitive / dullness | **Pilgrim 10% Vitamin C Face Serum** or **Minimalist 10% Advanced Vitamin C Serum** | 10% is described as the sweet spot for brightness with lower irritation risk.[3][13][16] |
| Dark spots / pigmentation stronger | **Pilgrim 15% Vitamin C Face Serum** or **Foxtale 15% L-Ascorbic Acid Serum** | Higher strength is suggested for stubborn dark spots.[3][14] |
| Budget-friendly, widely available | **Garnier Bright Complete Vitamin C Serum** or **Biotique Vitamin C Dark Spot Solution Serum** | Both are marketed in India for dark spots and dullness.[9][12] |

If you want **one single recommendation**, I’d go with **Minimalist 10% Advanced Vitamin C Serum** for most people starting out, or **Pilgrim 10% Vitamin C Face Serum** if you want a formula explicitly positioned for dullness + dark spots.[13][16] For more stubborn marks, **Pilgrim 15%** is the safer “stronger” step-up.[3]

A few important points:
- Vitamin C helps with **dark spots, pigmentation, and dullness** by inhibiting tyrosinase and reducing melanin production.[3][5]
- For best results, use it **in the morning under sunscreen**.[3]
- If your skin is easily irritated, start with **10%** rather than jumping to 15–23%.[3]
